Article 1.1: What Is Funded Futures Network?

Warren's summary

Summarize this rule
Overview

Funded Futures Network (FFN) is a proprietary trading firm that provides traders with simulated funded accounts to trade futures markets, and live accounts with real FFN capital through the FFN Institution. Traders buy an evaluation account as a one-time purchase, and upon passing the evaluation, receive a funded account with a profit-sharing arrangement.

How It Works: Step by Step
Choose your account type, style, and size. Every account is a one-time purchase, priced from $148 to $750.
Trade the evaluation account and hit the profit target without breaking any rules.
Pass review. OG accounts require an Exhibition stage to build a buffer before funding. MAX accounts go straight to funded.
Receive your funded (Sim-Funded Pro) account.
Trade your funded account and withdraw profits: same-day requests, no minimum wait day.
Key Platform Facts
Platform: Rithmic or Nexus Connect
Evaluation accounts per user: no limit (up to 5 active Sim Funded accounts at one time)
Real-time balance dashboard provided
Avg. support response time: 10 seconds
Support email: support@fundedfuturesnetwork.com
Discord (community + discounts): discord.gg/T5GpWm7cF8
NOTE FOR SUPPORT STAFF FFN does not charge hidden fees. Traders pay a one-time account purchase, an evaluation reset fee if needed ($100 on Standard MAX; $114 to $620 on STEADY, depending on account size), and a $120 activation fee when moving to a funded account (may be waived during promotions). STEADY accounts have no activation fee (Article 2.5). There are no payout fees.
